summary: @servicetitan/contentful-proxy ships install-time alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string-array dictionary of ~2000 tokens, mangled identifiers) whose contents are unrelated to the package's stated purpose. The declared `main` (`dist/index.js`) is a small NSwag-generated Contentful axios client and never references `math_init.js`; the obfuscated payload is reachable only via the preinstall dropper. The `repository` URL in `package.json` points at a nonexistent `servicetitan/contentful-proxy` GitHub path, consistent with a hijack of the `@servicetitan` scope. Installing this package causes an alien language runtime to execute opaque attacker-controlled code on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
